profile.visual_desc: Heavy navy plate armor with a red cape and waist cloth. Features a horned helmet with a red plume.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Dark blue visor with narrow, glowing red eyes. Menacing, shadowed expression behind a heavy metallic helm.
profile.weapon_desc: Large silver-bladed trident polearm held with both hands.
profile.step1_ready: Standing three-quarter front view, holding the polearm diagonally across the torso.
profile.step2_windup: Shifts weight forward, pulling the weapon back to prepare a heavy downward sweep.
profile.step3_impact: Lunges forward, creating a large, jagged golden-white energy arc that sweeps from top-left to bottom-right.
profile.step4_finish: Settles into a low crouch as the energy trail dissipates and the weapon rests near the ground.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The golden energy arc in Frame 4 must align with the downward-right diagonal trajectory of the polearm head.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation follows reference standards. Sequence shows proper windup and aligned VFX without orientation errors.
